clips.title: 彭博有限合伙企业：美国职位空缺回升，消费者信心却下滑

subtitles.en: What do you say? Well, we're seeing Americans a little more disappointed in the way the economy is going than we anticipated, and we're also seeing better than expected Joltz job openings.
subtitles.zh: 我们看到美国人对经济走向的失望程度高于预期，同时职位空缺数据也好于预期。
en_highlights: better than expected Joltz job openings

subtitles.en: They're down from what they were in the month of, down from what they were in the month of May.
en_highlights: down from what they were in the month of May

subtitles.en: These are the latest numbers, 7,594,000 down from 7,618,000 in April.
subtitles.zh: 最新数据为759.4万，低于4月的761.8万。

subtitles.en: The quits rate is 1.9% that is unchanged, so some strength in the jobs numbers.
subtitles.zh: 离职率为1.9%，保持不变，就业数据显现一定韧性。

subtitles.en: Now we've got the revision to the Joltz number, and we've actually gone up a little bit, 7,594,000, as I said, and the revised April number is 7,585,000, so up by a few there's
subtitles.zh: 职位空缺数据上修，最新为759.4万，4月修正值为758.5万，显示职位空缺比之前认为的要多。

subtitles.en: more job openings out there than thought. Now in terms of consumer confidence, 91.2, that is down from 93.1 as an initial estimate,
subtitles.zh: 消费者信心指数为91.2，低于初值93.1。

subtitles.en: but 90.6 is the revised, so it's up a little bit, but both numbers are not very strong for consumer confidence.
subtitles.zh: 修正值为90.6，略有上升，但两个数值均显示消费者信心不强。
en_highlights: not very strong for consumer confidence

subtitles.en: The present situation, 114, from 121.2, and the expectations index is unchanged at 74.4,
subtitles.zh: 现状指数从121.2降至114，预期指数持平于74.4。

subtitles.en: so at this point what we've got is consumers still reacting to the gasoline prices I would
subtitles.zh: 目前来看，消费者仍在应对汽油价格的影响，尽管当月价格有所下降。
en_highlights: consumers still reacting to the gasoline prices

subtitles.en: imagine, even though they came down during the month and people thought that might lead to something.
subtitles.zh: 人们原本以为价格下降会带来一些变化。
